content: The word subspace formulation presented in Section "Word subspace" is a practical and compact way to represent sets of word vectors, retaining most of the variability of features. However, as seen in the BOW features, the frequency of words is relevant information that can improve the characterization of a text. To incorporate this information into the word subspace modeling, we propose an extension of the word subspace, called the term-frequency (TF) weighted word subspace.
